closed.review.beat: The apprentice finds the first torn page, hidden behind a rock on the canyon path.

closed.endings.beat: A gust of wind blows a page onto the trail, with a small ending stuck to it.

closed.compound.beat: Two small words join into one bridge over a gully, and the apprentice reads each part.

closed.vccv-double.beat: Twin consonants sit in the middle of a word and split into one letter each.

closed.vccv.beat: Two different consonants in the middle of a word split apart, as in a camp napkin.

closed.vcccv.beat: Three consonants sit in the middle, and the apprentice keeps a blend together or splits after the second consonant.

closed.three.beat: A long word on the final cliff has three closed syllables, and the apprentice reads it in three parts.
